{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and converted ones
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
converted_count = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted orders among loyal customers: {converted_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")
print(f"Rounded conversion rate: {conversion_rate:.3f}")"}
